# BJP Tamil Nadu — Local Body Candidate Application Portal 2026

> Official candidate registration and verification portal for Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Tamil Nadu Local Body Elections 2026-27.

## Portal Overview
- Organization: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) – Tamil Nadu
- Website: https://tnbjp.com/
- Target Audience: Local body election candidates across all 38 districts of Tamil Nadu.

## Core Features
- Online Candidate Application: Interactive chat workflow to submit candidate details, electoral EPIC voter verification, and ward/panchayat preferences.
- Candidate Verification Portal: Instant QR-code and mobile-based verification of submitted candidate applications.
- Multi-Language Support: Available in English and Tamil (தமிழ்).

## Key Routes
- Candidate Application: https://tnbjp.com/
- Candidate Verification: https://tnbjp.com/verify
- Admin Management Suite: https://tnbjp.com/admin/login
